question_or_proposition: For cadmium at Outfall 001, does the Part I Section A table row establish any enforceable numeric effluent limitation (mass or concentration) applicable for compliance comparison, or does it establish only a monitoring-and-reporting requirement—quarterly grab sampling with results reported and no enforceable numeric permit limits in any averaging period?
required_context: Part I Section A limitations and monitoring requirements table, including column headers for mass limits, concentration limits, measurement frequency, and sample type
Cadmium row: N/A in all mass-limit and concentration-limit cells except 7-DAY AVG (mg/L) = Report; measurement frequency 1/Quarter; sample type Grab
Introductory authorization language that discharges shall be limited and monitored as specified in the table
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf Page 4, Section part_i, Cadmium row
notes: Resolution determines whether cadmium measurements are evaluated against an enforceable numeric limit (Purpose A), which monitoring and reporting requirements are treated as applicable (Purpose B), and how missing cadmium results are classified when no ordinary numeric reported value is available (Purpose C).
